research_findings: Reviewed the codebase and found a TODO regarding rate limiting the waitlist API in src/app/actions/waitlist.ts.
Discovered that Upstash is used across the system but @upstash/ratelimit was not installed in package.json.
Identified that waitlist joins require protection against high-volume abuse.
features_improved: Refactored the joinWaitlist action to conditionally apply a rate limit using Upstash Redis if environment variables are present, ensuring graceful degradation if not.
Implemented a token bucket / sliding window rate limiter (3 requests per 10 seconds) specifically tailored for waitlist submissions to prevent spam while allowing normal user interaction.
new_features_added: Introduced waitlistRatelimit in src/lib/ratelimit.ts which securely checks IP-based limits.
Added testing infrastructure and unit tests (src/app/actions/__tests__/waitlist.test.ts) to verify the new rate limiter behavior, including when limits are exceeded or missing.
next_steps_for_next_run: Implement generalized rate limiting across other unauthenticated endpoints like contact forms or problem-intro generation if applicable.
Explore upgrading existing AI dependencies and testing out more capable models if permitted by the user plan constraints.
